questions.text: In LEA terms, environmental psychology is best applied to architecture by asking how:

options.text: A building can ignore user behavior once code minimums are met
Physical settings and users affect one another through behavior, experience, and control
Only structural systems determine whether a space works
Psychological response can be measured only by room area

rationale.a: Code minimums do not replace behavior and perception analysis.
rationale.c: Structure matters, but this topic is about person-environment response.
rationale.d: Room area alone does not capture privacy, control, or perception.
rationale.correct: Environmental psychology links people and physical settings, so the architectural issue is behavior and experience in space.
rationale.takeaway: Environmental psychology links people and physical settings, so the architectural issue is behavior and experience in space.
